a.description: A batch of matrices with shape ``[..., m, m]``.

b.description: A batch of matrices with shape ``[..., m, n]`` if ``left_side`` is ``True`` or shape ``[..., n, m]`` otherwise.

left_side.description: describes which of the two matrix equations to solve; see above.

lower.description: describes which triangle of ``a`` should be used. The other triangle is ignored.

transpose_a.description: if ``True``, the value of ``a`` is transposed.

conjugate_a.description: if ``True``, the complex conjugate of ``a`` is used in the solve. Has no effect if ``a`` is real.

unit_diagonal.description: if ``True``, the diagonal of ``a`` is assumed to be unit (all 1s) and not accessed.

output.description: A batch of matrices the same shape and dtype as ``b``.
